svg.desc: Eight independent recurring owners, their DATASTORE artifacts and direct dependencies, plus the separate hourly operations and overnight accuracy lane.

color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-size: 20px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
CURRENT PRODUCTION SHAPE
Eight independently scheduled singleton owners exchange verified files and atomic pointers through C:/DATASTORE.
Quarter-hour phase offsets improve freshness; they do not create one central transaction.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
1 · CME/L2 RUNTIME
MBP-10 every 5 s · BBO every 15 s · OHLCV every 60 s
Owns current CME events, L2 authority, and 1 h cross-asset context

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
2 · LOOP A
15-minute boundary · 20 s recurring pre-start pause
Owns exact bar readiness, provider data, calculated features, and cycle state

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
3 · DAILY ALFRED
07:00 UTC · at most once per UTC date
Owns causal macro vintages, release context, readiness, and daily receipt

div.style: color: rgb(21, 53, 34) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
4 · ACTIVE PRICING
every 15 min · phase +1
Owns target outcomes and full option-pricing generations

div.style: color: rgb(21, 53, 34) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
5 · DIRECTIONAL LOOP B
every 15 min · phase +5
Owns calibrated 1 h / 4 h / 1 d / 1 w + weekly-component directional publications

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
6 · OPTIONS CAPTURE
every 15 min · phase +6
Owns prospective OPRA-first snapshots and pending fallback reconciliation

div.style: color: rgb(21, 53, 34) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
7 · STRATEGY RUNTIME
every 15 min · phase +10
Owns exact-leg candidates, audits, scores, ranks, and current Strategy authority

div.style: color: rgb(47, 32, 83) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
8 · STRATEGY-PROFIT TRAINING
daily at 22:00 UTC
Owns promoted 1 d / 1 w profit models; weekly day components reuse the 1 d model

div.style: color: rgb(63, 45, 0) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
OWNED PRICING WORKER
one local materialize/train pass after fast target publication
nonblocking · not independently scheduled

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HISTORY / BOOTSTRAP BOUNDARY
verified OPRA ohlcv-1h + cbbo-1m partitions
one-shot maintenance · not a recurring owner

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Loops do not call one another in memory. A solid edge above means the consumer verifies the producer's persisted artifact;
dotted edges are control/readiness/timing; thick edges are optional, historical, fallback, or asynchronous.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
1 · CME/L2 DATA
READS · retained pools/cme cursors/events; optional verified CME archive seed
WRITES · pools/cme/events · pools/cme/runtime · pools/cme/snapshots
pools/cme/features/cross-asset-context/databento/1h.parquet

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
2 · LOOP A DATA
READS · retained stocks/{symbol} provider/calculated state and cycle records
WRITES · stocks/{symbol}/bars|quotes|fundamentals|technicals|signals
loop-a/bar-readiness + bar-readiness-latest
.ducketz-loop-a-cycle.json + .ducketz-loop-a-complete.json

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
3 · ALFRED DATA
READS · canonical macro vintages + current ml/latest samples decision grid
WRITES · pools/macro/features/alfred-release-context/fred
ml/macro-readiness(-latest) · ml/fred-alfred-runtime(-latest)

div.style: color: rgb(21, 53, 34) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
4 · ACTIVE PRICING DATA
READS · Loop A readiness/bars · ALFRED FEDFUNDS · earlier option snapshots
optional ml/option-pricing-loop-native-* model/materialization
WRITES · ml/option-pricing-target-outcomes + target-latest
ml/option-pricing-runs + option-pricing-latest · predictions/evaluations/surfaces

div.style: color: rgb(21, 53, 34) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
5 · LOOP B DATA
READS · Loop A stock evidence · CME context · ALFRED readiness/context
option snapshots/features · optional Pricing surfaces
WRITES · immutable ml/runs/{run}/samples|predictions|evaluations|monitoring
authoritative ml/latest/run.json

div.style: color: rgb(20, 35, 58) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
6 · OPTIONS DATA
READS · Loop A readiness/latest-complete · Pricing target barrier
pending state + verified history cursors
WRITES · stocks/{symbol}/options/snapshots/{provider}
stocks/{symbol}/options/latest/{provider}.json · options/pending-captures

div.style: color: rgb(21, 53, 34) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
7 · STRATEGY DATA
READS · ml/latest · option snapshot heads · ml/option-pricing-latest
Loop A stock BBO · ml/strategy-profit-training-latest
WRITES · ml/strategy-runs/{run}/strategy-candidates + strategy-audit
authoritative ml/strategy-latest/run.json

div.style: color: rgb(47, 32, 83) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
8 · STRATEGY-PROFIT TRAINING DATA
READS · Loop B samples/predictions · Loop A 1 h stock bars
market-data/databento/opra/OPRA.PILLAR/{ohlcv-1h,cbbo-1m}
WRITES · ml/strategy-profit-modeled-outcomes · ml/strategy-models
ml/strategy-profit-training-runs + strategy-profit-training-latest

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Rolling Forecast UI ← ml/latest
Options Strategy UI ← ml/strategy-latest
monitor validates backend value/label parity; visual inspection occurs only when the app is already open

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; font-size: 18px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
loops-hourly-operations
Loops Monitor + Adaptive Trainer
one wake every local hour at :42

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
EVERY WAKE
run compact scheduled guardian once
verify all 8 process pairs, locks, logs, pointers, receipts, lineage, UI parity, storage
at most one allowlisted liveness repair; zero orders

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
ELIGIBLE XNYS SESSION
one bounded 45-minute overnight stage per wake · 13:42–05:42 PT
17 stable stages; 14:42 selects daily/weekly monitor; only 02:42 may build one shadow experiment
05:42 pre-open freeze · no production model/pointer/order mutation

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
OPERATIONS EVIDENCE
READS · root runtime locks · logs/ducketz · current authorities + receipts
WRITES ONLY WHEN WARRANTED · logs/ducketz/system-guardian/audit
stage checkpoints / bounded shadow evidence; unchanged or immature evidence is an explicit skip
